context: Review item 8.7 asked to profile first and stop if the saving is under 10 ms.
decision: Leave the per-command spawns as they are. Measured on macOS, `task list` spawns twice: git rev-parse (7.9 ms, needed to find the repo) and mount (6.2 ms, filesystem kind). The branch is already read from .git/HEAD. Caching the filesystem kind would save about 6 ms, under the 10 ms bar the review set, and adds a cache file that can go stale when a folder moves to another disk.
title: Review 8.7: no spawn cache
